proposed_from.topic: Characterize the universal rank-preservation covariance boundary for least-favourable potential-outcome completion under balanced randomization, with the presolve capsule embedded in this queued entry.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: {"closest_results":"The closest causal result is Aronow, Green, and Lee's two-arm comonotone sharp variance bound. The closest general computational result is Brennan et al.'s integer-program completion. Tchen supplies the classical supermodular-order ingredient, and Laurent--Seminaroti supply a structured quadratic-assignment analogue.","consumer_delta":"A causal-bootstrap analyst can decide in \\(O(K^2)\\) time whether sorting once is a valid least-favourable completion for a stated covariance loss, audit the decision with exact \\(K=3,N=6\\) calculations, and learn when no single rank completion can conservatively represent a multi-contrast covariance matrix. The open extension asks for an analogous label-free certificate only on covariance tensors realizable by fixed-count, marginally balanced assignment laws.","non_subsumption":"The proposal does not claim a new rearrangement inequality. Its first theorem derives the causal graph-Laplacian cone from the design covariance formula and proves necessity by marginally isolated binary witnesses, including an explicit non-Laplacian loss calculation. Its second theorem classifies all contrast matrices for which every rank-one scalarization lies in that cone. The nonexchangeable extension is not posed over arbitrary arrays: its exact probability-simplex moment representation, covariance identities, feasibility constraints, and unit-relabeling quotient define the open domain.","precise_gap":"No located source characterizes the exact set of scalarizations \\((C,W)\\) for which common ranks maximize complete-randomization covariance for every armwise marginal collection, nor the stronger boundary at which the entire contrast covariance matrix is universally dominated in Loewner order. For nonexchangeable balanced designs, no located source characterizes which realizable assignment-covariance orbits meet the universal identity-optimal cone or gives a polynomial recognition and separation certificate."}

seed_details.seed: Graph-Laplacian rank cone and Loewner boundary
seed_details.anchor_read: Aronow, Green, and Lee were read at the Introduction, Section 3, Lemma 1 and its proof, equations (7)--(11), and the Discussion. Brennan et al. were read at the Introduction, the quadratic variance formulation, the integer program in equation (4), Theorem 1 and its proof architecture, and the Conclusion.
seed_details.live_opportunity: The two-arm comonotone endpoint is analytic, while the generalized causal bootstrap resorts to instance-specific integer optimization. The missing object is the exact multi-contrast matrix cone on which one common-rank completion is universally least favourable.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the scalar Hoeffding covariance term by the complete-randomization identity for \(\operatorname{tr}\{W\operatorname{Cov}_Z(C\widehat{\bar Y})\}\), then test whether every pairwise covariance deficit has a nonnegative coefficient.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for multi-arm sharp covariance bounds, universal comonotone quadratic objectives, and rank-preserving causal bootstrap contrast matrices found general supermodular-order results and computational multi-marginal transport, but no causal graph-Laplacian or Loewner classification.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Tchen because a quadratic objective is supermodular exactly when its cross-partials are nonnegative.
seed_details.rebuttal: Tchen supplies the extremal-order ingredient, not the design-to-cost reduction, the exact contrast-risk cone \(C^{\mathsf T}WC\), or the classification showing that universal positive-semidefinite covariance dominance collapses to one pairwise contrast.
seed_details.burned_reason: The graph-Laplacian/Loewner angle passed mathematics but remained incremental after maximal fixed-count strengthening; the field-tier computational and witness-completeness core stayed open.

seed_details.seed: Cut-cone certificate for nonexchangeable balanced designs
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the assignment-covariance quadratic form, equation (4), Sections 4--5, Theorem 1 with its feasibility proof, and the Conclusion were read.
seed_details.live_opportunity: Brennan et al. make general assignment kernels computationally accessible but leave open when a rank completion is optimal without solving the integer program.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the exchangeable complete-randomization covariance identity by a block kernel \(\Omega^{ab}_{ij}\); the pairwise rearrangement step then becomes a simultaneous quadratic-assignment problem over arm-specific permutations.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for rank-preserving completion with general randomization kernels and for universal identity-optimal quadratic assignment found Robinson--Toeplitz sufficient classes, but not a necessary-and-sufficient causal kernel certificate.
seed_details.red_team: This is merely the Robinsonian quadratic-assignment theorem under causal notation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The causal problem is multi-block, permits several arm permutations, and asks necessity over every ordered marginal vector; the Robinson--Toeplitz theorem is a sufficient two-matrix identity-optimal result and explicitly fails without its Toeplitz restriction.

seed_details.seed: Dual-tight hypergraph certificate for zero realization loss
seed_details.anchor_read: The banked proposal's project justification, variance certificate, open question, and reviewer strengthening path were read. Gao, Ge, and Qian were read at the Introduction, Section 2, Theorem 1 and its proof sketch, the quadratic extension, and the Discussion.
seed_details.live_opportunity: The banked proposal proves only a rate for converting fractional multi-marginal plans into common-row finite populations; it does not decide when the conversion is exact.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After transport duality identifies the tight support face, replace approximate hierarchical repair by an integrality test for the incidence matrix of that face.
seed_details.destination_search: The adjacent search found non-Monge extreme-point geometry and discrete quadratic transport, but no polynomial iff certificate for an \(N\)-row optimizer on an arbitrary dual-tight face.
seed_details.red_team: Zero gap is equivalent by definition to an integer feasible point on the tight face.
seed_details.rebuttal: The publishable content would be a structural and polynomially checkable characterization, such as balanced hypergraph or total-unimodularity geometry, not the tautological integer-feasibility restatement.

seed_details.seed: Residual rank cone for regression-adjusted multi-arm experiments
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Section 4.2 on out-of-sample regression residuals, the general quadratic program, the asymptotic theorem, and the Conclusion were read.
seed_details.live_opportunity: Regression adjustment changes the armwise objects from outcomes to residuals, while existing work computes sharp endpoints without a universal contrast-geometry certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Substitute predictable residual schedules into the complete-randomization covariance decomposition and determine whether the same graph-Laplacian condition survives arm-specific residualization.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found sharp two-arm regression-residual bounds but no multi-arm universal rank cone.
seed_details.red_team: This follows verbatim by replacing outcomes with residuals.
seed_details.rebuttal: That objection holds for fixed out-of-sample residuals, so the seed lacks an independent kernel unless adjustment is estimated under the realized assignment.

seed_details.anchor_read: Brennan et al. were read at the small-sample motivation, variance program, simulation discussion, and Conclusion. Imbens and Menzel were read at the Introduction, causal-bootstrap construction, least-favourable limiting experiment, Lemma 1 and Proposition 1 proofs based on convex order, and the large-sample coverage argument.
seed_details.live_opportunity: Worst variance and asymptotic least favourability do not determine rejection probabilities of a studentized statistic in finite populations.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The convex-order proof for the unstudentized estimator fails when the random denominator changes with the completion; the replacement target is exact randomization-tail optimization.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for studentized causal-bootstrap tail dominance found asymptotic and Edgeworth refinements, not finite-sample dominance over completions.
seed_details.red_team: Variance maximization plus symmetry already implies the widest tails.
seed_details.rebuttal: Studentization destroys that implication, and Brennan et al.'s finite example shows that worst-variance completion need not yield conservative small-sample coverage.
seed_details.disposition: dropped after ranking because the exact optimizer is likely critical-value specific

seed_details.seed: Sharp covariance deficit under a rank-discordance budget
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Section 3, the Hoeffding lemma and proof, the quantile estimator, and the Discussion were read.
seed_details.live_opportunity: The sharp endpoint jumps directly to comonotonicity and does not quantify variance loss when rank preservation is substantively implausible.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the unrestricted Fr\'{e}chet class in the Hoeffding proof by a copula slice with fixed Kendall dependence or bounded discordant mass.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search found treatment-effect-distribution bounds under dependence information, but not a closed covariance-deficit frontier for randomization variance.
seed_details.red_team: This is a standard constrained-copula optimization with no causal content.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact critical dependence level for a design-variance conclusion and its finite-population realization would be causal and operational, but the nonlinear copula slice makes feasibility uncertain.

seed_details.anchor_read: The banked proposal's TLDR, transport constructions, variance certificate, exact-constant open question, README, and reviewer objections were read.
seed_details.live_opportunity: The existing proposal leaves the limit of \(N\Delta_N\) and the extremal dual-tight geometry unresolved.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace separate multiscale upper and padded-obstruction lower bounds by a compactness or arithmetic classification of all asymptotically tight support faces.
seed_details.destination_search: The adjacent search found non-Monge and mixability geometry but no exact same-denominator causal completion constant.
seed_details.red_team: The normalized gap may oscillate arithmetically, so there is no single constant to estimate.
seed_details.rebuttal: The honest target can be the exact subsequential-limit set, but the required face classification is substantially less feasible than the rank-cone certificate.

seed_details.seed: History-tree gluing of nodewise rank extrema
seed_details.anchor_read: The failed proposal's completion class and open question, the angle review's well-posedness objection, and the recommended history-tree repair were read.
seed_details.live_opportunity: A legal adaptive design requires one ex ante potential-outcome table, whereas rectangular nodewise optimization chooses incompatible couplings across histories.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace nodewise coupling feasibility by a projective-consistency problem over the entire observed-history tree before applying martingale variance decomposition.
seed_details.destination_search: The targeted prior-art review found adaptive martingale inference and static transport envelopes, but no global completion theorem.
seed_details.red_team: This is ordinary marginal consistency on a finite tree and follows from a gluing lemma.
seed_details.rebuttal: The same labelled units and history-dependent residual maps impose nonrectangular constraints not covered by ordinary pairwise gluing, but even defining the feasible object cleanly remains difficult.

seed_details.seed: Sign-switched rank completion for a single multi-arm contrast
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, multi-marginal formulation, quadratic objective, Theorem 1 and proof sketch, minimax proposition, and Discussion were read.
seed_details.live_opportunity: A scalar contrast with several positive and negative coefficients suggests sorting arms in two opposite rank groups rather than using common ranks.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Apply sign changes to the quadratic contrast cost and check the compatibility of all mixed partials before invoking the comonotone optimizer.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search found the compatible-cost or sign-switched supermodularity theorem in multi-marginal risk aggregation.
seed_details.red_team: The optimizer is already the standard compatible-cost comonotone coupling after changing signs.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds, so this seed is not novel even though it gives a useful causal corollary.
